design_description: A tropical, vacation-inspired design built around a bright turquoise base with beach sunset artwork integrated into the lower half of the jersey. White palm tree silhouettes, ocean waves, birds, and a large setting sun create a relaxed coastal atmosphere, while rough brushstroke textures on the shoulders add energy and movement. The mismatched red and green sleeves reinforce the playful summer aesthetic, giving the kit a festive, almost carnival-like personality. Overall, the jersey feels vibrant, fun, and lifestyle-driven — more like a beach party football shirt than a traditional competitive kit.
